rule: mFRR capacity market: offer the megawatt, up direction, in every hour of the day (gate 07:30 the day before).
mFRR energy market: in every quarter of a held hour, an energy bid at the price in the issue (gate 45 minutes before the quarter).
Day-ahead market: a buy order for the quarters in the issue, at the issue's limit price (gate 12:00 the day before); down-regulation refills the store when not holding.
Take every activation the market clears; never run a deliberate imbalance; keep the store able to deliver two quarters at full power.
limits: A price-taker is assumed to be awarded capacity in every eligible hour; the residual requirement and any price impact of a 1 MW bid in a thin zone are not modelled - both would lower the figure.
Scheduled and direct activation are priced alike; pro-rata at the margin and bid indivisibility are not modelled.
Degradation 30 EUR per MWh cycled, round-trip efficiency 0.88; warranties that cap cycling are shown as the 1.5-cycle case.
Publication lag of the balancing data was measured at 25-40 minutes on one evening; the rule does not depend on it.

SE1: FCR-N, auction 1: offer the most the store allows in every hour of the day, at price 0 (gate 00:30 the day before): 0.74 MW per MW with two hours of storage, 0.53 with one.
Intraday market: keep the store in the band in the issue, aiming for its middle; buy and sell at the limits in the issue, close to the day-ahead price.
Day-ahead market: a buy order for the quarters in the issue, at the issue's limit price (gate 12:00 the day before), taken while the store is below the middle of its band.
Deliver every FCR-N activation; never run a deliberate imbalance; keep an hour of the FCR-N offer in the store each way.

SE1: FCR-N: a price-taker is assumed to be awarded in auction 1 in every hour, at the national price; acceptance risk and auction 2 are not modelled.
FCR-N activation follows the grid frequency as it was measured; activated energy is settled at that quarter's regulation price; an hour the store cannot cover is repaid at 1.5 times its price.
Intraday trades are assumed to fill at the issue's limits; degradation 30 EUR per MWh cycled, round-trip efficiency 0.88. FCR-N cycling is set by the grid, so no cycle cap applies.
